g.title: j1394848684
g.text: It was as easy as a problem
Talk it out, smack it around jajaja

g.title: j4073524959
g.text: You have a ton to be happy about, though.

g.title: j3413058418
g.text: I learned the hard way in Duviri that "fixing feelings" is sometimes the worse choice.

g.title: j1101055654
g.text: People understood that part of me
Will never let that sink in

g.title: j2940043776
g.text: But you've told me about what happens

g.title: j3825720703
g.text: I wish I could be different
But I am who I am
And I gave up apologizing for that

g.title: j3304773402
g.text: His heart is too cold as it is tho

g.title: j2670730543
g.text: What can we do to get your mind off things? Or would you prefer to stay in?

g.title: j2797672
g.text: We can only hope he's playing the long game.

g.title: j1039940225
g.text: Or, we could go out and kill things

g.title: j2360483693
g.text: The only thing I hope for where that cabrón is involved
Is a long ride in an elevator

g.title: j803253642
g.text: That's a mental image that cheers me up

g.title: j388757638
g.text: Sit at the bar with M&V
Might get my mind off it

g.title: j880185211
g.text: Take the pain out of my thoughts
By putting the pain into someone else's
